```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(here)
# Labels (adjust if needed)
temp_label <- "Temperate"
lytic_label <- "Lytic"


#hmm <- read.csv(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "output", "inph_functional_data.csv"),row.names=1) 
hmm <- read.csv(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "output", "UHGV_functional_data.csv"),row.names=1) 
hmm<- subset(hmm, hmm$newgtdb_Phylum=="Bacillota" &  hmm$f_spor==TRUE)
hmm<- subset(hmm, hmm$COGlet=="Sp")
#hmm<- subset(hmm, hmm$completeness >=

# Basic cleaning
df <- hmm %>%
  dplyr::rename(phage_id = Accession, gene_name = gene_name, lifestyle = lifestyle) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phage_id) & !is.na(lifestyle) & !is.na(gene_name))


df_genome_gene <- df %>%
  distinct(phage_id, gene_name, lifestyle, COGlet)

raw_copy_counts <- df %>%
  count(phage_id, gene_name, name = "copies")

```

```{r}
totals <- df_genome_gene %>%
  distinct(phage_id, lifestyle) %>%    # one row per genome
  count(lifestyle, name = "n_genomes")

total_temp  <- totals %>% filter(lifestyle == temp_label)  %>% pull(n_genomes) %>% { if(length(.)==0) 0 else . }
total_lytic <- totals %>% filter(lifestyle == lytic_label) %>% pull(n_genomes) %>% { if(length(.)==0) 0 else . }

if((total_temp + total_lytic) == 0) stop("No genomes with the specified lifestyle labels found.")

gene_counts <- df_genome_gene %>%
  count(gene_name, lifestyle, name = "n") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lifestyle, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
# Safety: create explicit columns Temperate & Lytic (or use your labels)
if(!("Temperate" %in% colnames(gene_counts)) && temp_label %in% colnames(gene_counts)) {
  gene_counts <- gene_counts %>% rename(Temperate = !!temp_label)
}
if(!("Lytic" %in% colnames(gene_counts) && lytic_label %in% colnames(gene_counts))) {
  # if different labels, adapt above
}
# If still missing, create zeros
gene_counts <- gene_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Temperate = ifelse(is.na(Temperate), 0L, as.integer(Temperate)),
    Lytic    = ifelse(is.na(Lytic),    0L, as.integer(Lytic))
  )

```

```{r}
results_hg <- gene_counts %>%
  mutate(
    q = Temperate,
    k = Temperate + Lytic,
    m = total_temp,
    n = total_lytic,
    # if k==0 (gene not seen), set p=1 to avoid errors
    p_hyper = ifelse(k == 0, 1, phyper(q - 1, m, n, k, lower.tail = FALSE)),
    # optional continuity-corrected OR for interpretation (pseudo-count 0.5)
    or_cc = ((Temperate + 0.5) / ( (m - Temperate) + 0.5 )) / ((Lytic + 0.5) / ( (n - Lytic) + 0.5 )),
    prop_temp = Temperate / pmax(m,1),
    prop_lytic = Lytic / pmax(n,1),
    direction = case_when(
      prop_temp > prop_lytic ~ "Temperate",
      prop_temp < prop_lytic ~ "Lytic",
      TRUE ~ "Equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_hyper) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_hyper, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  select(gene_name, Temperate, Lytic, k, m, n, prop_temp, prop_lytic, direction, or_cc, p_hyper, p_adj)

```

```{r}
fisher_per_gene <- function(a, m_total, c, n_total) {
  # a = temperate with gene, c = lytic with gene
  b <- m_total - a
  d <- n_total - c
  mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ft <- fisher.test(mat, alternative = "greater") # "greater" tests enrichment in row1 (temperate)
  list(p.value = ft$p.value, estimate = ft$estimate, conf.int = ft$conf.int)
}

# vectorized application
fisher_results <- gene_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    fisher = list(fisher_per_gene(Temperate, total_temp, Lytic, total_lytic)),
    p_fisher = fisher$p.value,
    OR = fisher$estimate,
    CI_low = fisher$conf.int[1],
    CI_high = fisher$conf.int[2]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_fisher_adj = p.adjust(p_fisher, method = "BH")) %>%
  select(gene_name, Temperate, Lytic, OR, CI_low, CI_high, p_fisher, p_fisher_adj)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# Inputs (assume gene_counts from previous steps: columns gene_name, Temperate, Lytic)
# gene_counts should have integer counts:
# Temperate = # temperate genomes with gene
# Lytic    = # lytic genomes with gene
# and you must have total_temp, total_lytic available (genomes by lifestyle)

compute_fisher_rows <- function(a, m_total, c, n_total, conf.level = 0.95) {
  # a = Temperate with gene
  # m_total = total temperate genomes
  # c = Lytic with gene
  # n_total = total lytic genomes
  b <- m_total - a    # temperate without gene
  d <- n_total - c    # lytic without gene

  # safety: ensure non-negative
  if(any(c(a,b,c,d) < 0)) stop("Negative cell in contingency table")

  mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

  # Fisher two-sided for OR + CI (CI only returned for two.sided)
  ft2 <- fisher.test(mat, alternative = "two.sided", conf.level = conf.level)

  # One-sided p-value (Temperate enrichment)
  ft_greater <- fisher.test(mat, alternative = "greater")

  # continuity-corrected OR (adds 0.5 to avoid zeros)
  OR_cc <- ((a + 0.5) * (d + 0.5)) / ((b + 0.5) * (c + 0.5))

  # Use fisher estimate if available, else fall back to OR_cc
  OR_ft <- if(!is.null(ft2$estimate)) as.numeric(ft2$estimate) else OR_cc

  # Conf interval: prefer fisher's conf.int; if missing, approximate on log scale using continuity-corrected counts
  if(!is.null(ft2$conf.int) && length(ft2$conf.int) == 2 && all(is.finite(ft2$conf.int))) {
    CI_low <- ft2$conf.int[1]
    CI_high <- ft2$conf.int[2]
  } else {
    # approximate CI on log(OR_cc) using normal approx with continuity correction
    se_log_or <- sqrt(1/(a + 0.5) + 1/(b + 0.5) + 1/(c + 0.5) + 1/(d + 0.5))
    z <- qnorm((1 + conf.level) / 2)
    log_or <- log(OR_cc)
    CI_low <- exp(log_or - z * se_log_or)
    CI_high <- exp(log_or + z * se_log_or)
  }

  # log2 transforms (for symmetric interpretation)
  log2_OR_ft    <- log2(OR_ft)
  log2_CI_low   <- log2(CI_low)
  log2_CI_high  <- log2(CI_high)

  # return as named list
  list(
    a = a, b = b, c = c, d = d,
    OR_fisher = OR_ft,
    OR_cc = OR_cc,
    CI_low = CI_low,
    CI_high = CI_high,
    log2_OR = log2_OR_ft,
    log2_CI_low = log2_CI_low,
    log2_CI_high = log2_CI_high,
    p_two_sided = ft2$p.value,
    p_one_sided_greater = ft_greater$p.value
  )
}

# Apply across the gene table
fisher_results <- gene_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(compute_fisher_rows(Temperate, total_temp, Lytic, total_lytic))
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(res) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_two_sided_adj = p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "BH"),
    p_one_sided_greater_adj = p.adjust(p_one_sided_greater, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      log2_OR > 0 ~ "Temperate",
      log2_OR < 0 ~ "Lytic",
      TRUE ~ "Equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(gene_name, Temperate, Lytic, a, b, c, d,
         OR_fisher, OR_cc, log2_OR, log2_CI_low, log2_CI_high,
         p_two_sided, p_two_sided_adj,
         p_one_sided_greater, p_one_sided_greater_adj,
         direction)

inphared_fisher_results <- fisher_results
# Example: show top temperate-enriched by log2_OR
fisher_results %>% arrange(desc(log2_OR)) %>% head(20)


```


```{r}
library(ggrepel)

top_genes <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(p_two_sided_adj) %>%
  slice(1:10)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2_OR, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = gene_name), size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

plot_df <- fisher_results %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(p_two_sided_adj),
    direction = case_when(
      log2_OR > 0 ~ "Temperate",
      log2_OR < 0 ~ "Lytic",
      TRUE ~ "Equal"
    ),
    abs_log2_OR = abs(log2_OR)
  )

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2_OR, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs_log2_OR,
                 color = direction),
             alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "|log2(OR)|") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Temperate" = "#1f78b4",
    "Lytic" = "#e31a1c",
    "Equal" = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(Odds Ratio)",
    y = "-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Enriched in"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
#inph_fisher_results <- fisher_results
fisher_results <- subset(fisher_results, fisher_results$gene_name!="dipeptidyl-peptidase 6 (EC 3.4.22.-) (Dipeptidyl-peptidase VI) (DPP VI) (Endopeptidase II) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-L-diamino acid endopeptidase II) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-MESO-diaminopimelate peptidase II)")
uhgv_fisher_results <- fisher_results
uhgv_fisher_results$set <- "uhgv"
inph_fisher_results$set <- "inph"
test <- bind_rows(inph_fisher_results, uhgv_fisher_results)
test <- subset(test, test$gene_name!="dipeptidyl-peptidase 6 (EC 3.4.22.-) (Dipeptidyl-peptidase VI) (DPP VI) (Endopeptidase II) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-L-diamino acid endopeptidase II) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-MESO-diaminopimelate peptidase II)" & test$gene_name!="gamma-D-glutamyl-L-diamino acid endopeptidase 1 (EC 3.4.19.11) (Endopeptidase I) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-L-diamino acid endopeptidase I) (Gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-diaminopimelate peptidase I)")

plot_df <- test %>%
  filter(p_two_sided_adj < 0.05) %>%
  filter((Temperate + Lytic) >= 8)


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    OR_plot = OR_cc,  # use continuity-corrected OR for stability
    direction = case_when(
      OR_plot > 1 ~ "Temperate",
      OR_plot < 1 ~ "Lytic",
      TRUE ~ "Equal"
    ),
    abs_log2_OR = abs(log2(OR_plot))
  ) %>%
  arrange(OR_plot)# + facet_wrap(~set, nrow=1)

library(ggplot2)



ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = set, y = reorder(gene_name, OR_plot))) +
  
  # vertical reference line

  
  # bubbles
  geom_point(aes(size = abs_log2_OR,
                 color = direction),
             alpha = 0.7) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Temperate" = "#1f78b4",
    "Lytic" = "#e31a1c",
    "Equal" = "grey70"
  )) +
  
  labs(
    y = "Gene",
    color = "Enriched in",
    size = "|log2(OR)|"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )


```
